units.source_text: 从地窖般狭窄的台阶上来，置身于厂麦的景观，紧张顿时松弛，舒快极了。

en.t: Climbing up from the narrow, cellar-like stairs and finding ourselves amid the scenery of Hanamugi, our tension suddenly eased, and we felt wonderfully refreshed.

units.source_text: 我们尽情观赏叶樱和松的景致、耸立在对面鳞次栉比的平安神富的郁葱森林的景致、

en.t: We gazed to our hearts' content at the sights of leafy cherry trees and pines, and at the lush forest of Heian Jingu standing densely across from us,

units.source_text: 京都市街尽头的朦胧的岚山，以及北方、贵船、卖里、会见罗等群山的姿影，

en.t: at hazy Arashiyama beyond the edge of the Kyoto city streets, and at the outlines of the northern mountains, including Kibune, Urizato, and Aemira,

units.source_text: 尔后才像个寺庙弟子的样子，脱掉了鞋袜，恭恭敬敬地进太庙堂里。

en.t: and only after that, behaving at last like temple disciples, we took off our shoes and socks and respectfully entered the taibyodo hall.

units.source_text: 昏暗的佛堂有二十四铺席宽，释边像摆在中央，

en.t: The dim Buddhist hall was about twenty-four tatami mats in size, with the statue of Shaka placed at the center,

units.source_text: 十六尊罗汉的金眸子在黑暗中闪闪发光。

en.t: and the golden eyes of the sixteen arhats glittered in the darkness.
